title: carlina hispanica subsp. major
intro: Carlina hispanica subsp. major, commonly known as the Spanish carline thistle, is a plant species in the sunflower family native to the Iberian Peninsula. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and research has shown that it exhibits various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and allergies. The therapeutic actions of Carlina hispanica subsp. major include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
